kind.description: edge: lumped, driven along a metal edge on layer, returning to reference. line: the reference plane of a calibrated measurement on a uniform line; segment is the cross-section where the drawn line ends, the line is understood to continue unchanged beyond it, and the S-parameters refer to its fundamental mode (solvers: de-embedded wave or line port). vertical: lumped, a z-directed sheet of width |segment| spanning the gap from conductor 'from' (or the bottom boundary) up to conductor 'to'.

z0_ohm.description: Reference impedance. 'line': the characteristic impedance of the line at the port, as a multiline TRL calibration defines it.

deembed_um.description: Line ports only: the reference plane lies this far from the segment, along the uniform line into the structure. The drawn stretch is part of the layout but de-embedded from the result.

quantity.description: sparams: a Touchstone file. curves: a CSV in long format with columns series,f_hz,value, one row per point, each series on its own frequency grid; the series are declared under 'series'.

reference_plane.description: Where the data are referenced, in terms of the layout.

calibration.description: Calibration and de-embedding chain, e.g. LRRM at the probe tips, then open-short pad de-embedding.

source_file.description: Upstream path the file was taken from; its hash is listed under source.files.

derive.description: Script in the case directory that computes the file from upstream raw data (e.g. a multiline TRL calibration). It fetches the raw data at the pinned commit and checks their hashes.

origin.description: file: the data as the source published them, or computed from its raw data. table: transcribed from a table of the source. digitized: read off a figure of the source; requires 'digitized'.

expr.description: What the series is, evaluable from any S-parameter result: db(Sij) = 20 log10|Sij|; deg(Sij) = phase in degrees; L, R, Q of an impedance X with L = Im(X)/(2 pi f) in nH, R = Re(X) in Ohm, Q = Im(X)/Re(X). X: Y11 = 1/Y11 (port 2 shorted), Y22 = 1/Y22, Z11 (port 2 open), Z22, Zdiff = Z11 + Z22 - Z12 - Z21 (differential), Zser = -1/Y12 (series branch of the pi model).

method.description: How it was read, e.g. 'vector paths extracted from the PDF' or 'WebPlotDigitizer on a 300 dpi raster'.

uncertainty.description: Estimated reading uncertainty in the units of the axes.

stack.description: Name of a file in stacks/, or a path ending in .yaml relative to the case.

ignore_layers.description: GDS layers drawn in the file that are not part of the problem: labels, markers, port helpers.

build.description: Script that reproduces the layout from the upstream source; CI reruns it.

source_file.description: Upstream path of the layout; when set, layout.gds must hash to it (listed under source.files).

provenance.description: original: the upstream GDS byte for byte. converted: generated from upstream design files (Gerber, DXF, KiCad) by layout.build. reconstructed: rebuilt from dimensions or drawings by layout.build.

outline_layer.description: GDS layer of the board outline. Required when the stack has lateral: outline; the dielectrics end there.

band.description: Band over which the case is meant to be compared.

open_questions.description: What still keeps the case from being fully reproducible. A case with open questions is marked incomplete.
